$comment: pDaftar POS backend — a separate Laravel application that shares ONE database
and ONE copy of pDaftar's domain code with the main backend.
The key line is the `App\` autoload mapping below. It points at
../backend/app, NOT at a copy. That is deliberate and it is the whole
safety argument for splitting the service at all: a POS sale is written by
pDaftar's own StoreDebtUseCase, so a POS sale and an app sale cannot drift
apart. Copying those files instead would put two versions of the sale rules
against one database, and the first time the main app changed the sale flow
the two would start disagreeing silently.
Consequence to know: this app cannot run without ../backend present. Deploy
them together. /api/pos/v1/health checks the link and fails loudly if it is
name: pdaftar/pos-backend
